parameters.query:
with target as (
  select cv.id as conversation_id, c.phone
  from public.conversations cv
  join public.contacts c on c.id = cv.contact_id
  where c.phone = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g') and cv.status <> 'resolved'
  order by cv.created_at desc limit 1
)
insert into public.messages (conversation_id, direction, message_type, message_text, metadata)
select target.conversation_id, 'outbound', 'chat', $2, jsonb_build_object('sent_by', 'nairobi', 'is_test', coalesce($3::boolean, false))
from target
returning conversation_id, (select phone from target) as chat_id, $2 as message_text;

update public.conversations
set should_respond = false,
    metadata = jsonb_set(coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb), '{paused_until}', to_jsonb((now() + (coalesce($2::int, 60)::text || ' minutes')::interval)::text))
where id = $1
returning id;

nodes.name: Pausar bot 60 min
nodes.notes: Recomendación pendiente de confirmar con Sebastián (NEXT_STEPS.md): un mensaje manual de Nairobi pausa el bot por defecto 60 min para no cruzarse con Nai en la misma conversación.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: ($('POST send-message → registrar').item.json.chat_id || '').toString().replace(/\D/g, ''), text: $('POST send-message → registrar').item.json.message_text }) }}

nodes.name: Enviar WhatsApp (Evolution)
nodes.notes: Migrado de WaAPI a Evolution API v2 el 2026-08-23 (R014). Endpoint /message/sendText/{instancia}, body {number, text} — el número va en dígitos, sin @c.us. Credencial 'Evolution API saliente' (header apikey). JSON.stringify evita romper el body con comillas o saltos de línea.

parameters.query:
update public.conversations cv
set should_respond = $2::boolean
from public.contacts c
where cv.contact_id = c.id and c.phone = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g')
returning cv.id, c.phone as chat_id, cv.should_respond as bot_enabled;

with resolved as (
  update public.escalations
  set status = 'resolved', resolved_at = now(), resolution_note = $2
  where id = $1
  returning conversation_id
)
update public.conversations c
set should_respond = true, status = 'active', metadata = c.metadata - 'paused_until'
from resolved r
where c.id = r.conversation_id
returning c.id, (select phone from public.contacts where id = c.contact_id) as chat_id, c.should_respond as bot_enabled;

nodes.name: POST escalation-resolve
nodes.notes: Al resolver, reactiva el bot automáticamente (should_respond=true, status='active', limpia metadata.paused_until) — Nairobi ya no necesita mantenerlo pausado manualmente.

nodes.name: POST policy → calcular cuotas
nodes.notes: Determinista: divide premium_total entre las cuotas según payment_frequency. No usa LLM.

parameters.query:
insert into public.policies (contact_id, insurer_id, product_id, quote_id, policy_number, status, premium_total, currency, payment_frequency, start_date, end_date, commission_pct)
select c.id, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'active', $6, coalesce($7,'USD'), $8, $9, $10, coalesce($11, i.commission_default_pct)
from public.contacts c, public.insurers i
where c.phone = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g') and i.id = $2
returning id, contact_id, currency;

nodes.name: Preparar filas de pago
nodes.notes: Un Code node puede devolver múltiples items directamente — así 'Insertar calendario de pagos' recibe un item por cuota y n8n lo inserta uno por uno automáticamente.

nodes.name: Reducir a 1 item (policy)
nodes.notes: Code node corre una sola vez para TODOS los items de entrada (default runOnceForAllItems) — reduce las N filas de pago insertadas a 1 solo item con policy_id, para que el siguiente INSERT de comisiones no se dispare N veces (evita duplicar comisiones por cuota).

parameters.query:
insert into public.commissions (policy_id, insurer_id, gross_amount, pct, net_amount, currency, status, period)
select $1, (select insurer_id from public.policies where id = $1),
       amount, (select commission_pct from public.policies where id = $1),
       round(amount * (select commission_pct from public.policies where id = $1) / 100, 2),
       (select currency from public.policies where id = $1), 'accrued', due_date
from public.payments where policy_id = $1;

nodes.name: Insertar cita
nodes.notes: El constraint 'no_overlap' (exclude using gist) en public.appointments es la capa dura final incluso si esta verificación previa tuviera una condición de carrera. Crear el evento en Google Calendar (nodo googleCalendar, no tool) es un paso posterior pendiente de credencial googleCalendarOAuth2Api (Fase 9) — guardar luego gcal_event_id con un UPDATE.

parameters.query: update public.reminders set scheduled_for = now() where id = $1 returning id;

nodes.name: POST reminder-send-now
nodes.notes: Solo adelanta scheduled_for a 'ahora' — el envío real ocurre en la próxima corrida horaria de W6 (o se puede forzar disparando W6 manualmente). Mantiene una sola fuente de lógica de envío en vez de duplicarla aquí.

parameters.query:
insert into public.integration_settings
  (integration_type, provider, is_active, status, metadata, last_checked_at, updated_by)
values ($1, $2, $3, 'pending', $4::jsonb, now(), 'panel')
on conflict (integration_type, coalesce(provider, ''))
do update set
  provider = excluded.provider,
  is_active = excluded.is_active,
  status = 'pending',
  metadata = excluded.metadata,
  last_checked_at = now(),
  updated_by = 'panel',
  updated_at = now()
returning id, integration_type, provider, is_active, status;

nodes.name: Upsert integration_settings
nodes.notes: Escribe solo metadata operativa (provider/is_active/status), nunca secretos. status siempre vuelve a 'pending' al guardar desde el panel -- confirmar 'connected' es responsabilidad de un chequeo real aparte (fuera de alcance de esta ronda), no de este nodo.

parameters.query:
insert into public.contacts (phone, name, email, customer_status, metadata)
values (regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g'), $2, $3, coalesce($4, 'Activo'), jsonb_build_object('source', 'panel_manual'))
on conflict (phone) do update set name = coalesce(excluded.name, contacts.name),
  email = coalesce(excluded.email, contacts.email), updated_at = now()
returning id, phone, name;

nodes.name: POST contact-create → insertar
nodes.notes: Idempotente por phone (unique constraint) — si ya existe, actualiza nombre/correo en vez de duplicar.
